title: The $p$-rationality of $\mathbb{Q}\left(\sqrt{-(kp+m)}\right)$ and $\mathbb{Q}\left(\sqrt{p(p+1)}\right)$
summary: In this paper, we construct new families of imaginary and real quadratic fields that are $p$-rational. In the imaginary case, we prove that for any positive integer $k$ and any integer $m$, the imaginary quadratic field $\mathbb{Q}\left(\sqrt{-(kp+m)}\right)$ is $p$-rational for sufficiently large primes $p$. The proof relies on Louboutin's bound on the class numbers of imaginary quadratic fields.
